raw_segments.text: Bag of corpseggas sopping in foul brine. A quiver of minnows, fat of a spongy tit-bit,
flash through the slits of his buttoned trouserfly. God becomes man, becomes fish,
becomes barnacle goose, becomes feather-bed mountain. Dead breaths I living breathe,
tread dead dust, devour a urinous awful from all dead.
Hald stark over the gunwale he breathes upward the stench of his green grave,
his leprous nose-holes snoring to the sun.
